_comment: Check-chain gates deliberately WITHOUT a poison pill. The meta-gate enforces a DECISION per gate, never a fixture per gate. A GATE IS ONE TERMINAL COMMAND, not one npm script — `skills:check` runs six, and keying by script name let one pill account for all of them. So an aggregate script pills the members that guard a Category-B artifact and exempts the rest by exact command — an unlisted, uncontracted gate fails `gates:poison`, so a 19th gate cannot be added silently. Mandatory-pill scope (docs/plans/green-but-unrealized.md §2 dec. 3): a gate guarding a committed Category-B artifact, or any gate added after 2026-07-31.

exempt.docs:check: Placement/reference linter over docs/**. Certifies no committed artifact's freshness — it asserts properties of prose that are re-derived on every run, so there is no stale-artifact false-green to construct.
exempt.docs:refs:gate: Reference-integrity drift gate. Already carries its own negative evidence: the BASELINE in check-docs-refs.mjs plus a DRIFT section that fails on newly-broken refs, and it demonstrably fired twice during this session's work.
exempt.plans:status: Validates the `Status:` line of every plan against a closed vocabulary. A malformed status is caught by the same parse that reads it; there is no derived artifact that could go stale while the check reports fresh.
exempt.plans:lint: Mermaid syntax linter. Pure parse of committed source with no artifact in between — the check IS the derivation, so it cannot be fresh about a stale output.
exempt.efficacy:check: Reads audit-effectiveness telemetry from the cloud store; advisory and degrades to skip when cloud is off. A pill would need a seeded database, which the tmpdir isolation cannot construct — contracting it properly needs a DB-backed oracle (no current requirement).
exempt.on-conflict:check: Static lint for raw-array-to-jsonb and ON CONFLICT misuse. Derives its verdict directly from the AST it parses; no intermediate committed artifact.
exempt.arch:coverage-gate: Owns the exit code for the observed-graph coverage envelope, which is Category A (gitignored, regenerated every render) — not a committed artifact whose staleness this gate alone certifies. Its own fail-closed contract is separately pinned in tests/gate-honesty.test.mjs (D6).
exempt.db:check-rls:gate: Asserts RLS posture against a live database. Same DB-fixture limitation as efficacy:check.
exempt.cli:flags:gate: Verifies every CLI registers its flags with assertKnownFlags. Derived from source at run time; the failure mode is a missing registration, which the gate reads directly rather than through a cached artifact.
exempt.knip:gate: Dead-code/unused-export detection over the live import graph. No committed artifact.
exempt.npm-args:gate: Scans docs and skills for an npm-run invocation whose flag npm would swallow. Pure text scan of committed source.
exempt.db:suites:gate: Asserts the DB integration suites are wired and disposable-DSN-guarded. Its own subject is test wiring; a pill would test the pill harness.
exempt.test: The suite runner itself. Its negative evidence is every failing assertion in tests/** — a poison pill here would be a test that tests whether tests fail.
exempt.gates:poison: The meta-gate itself. A pill for it would be a tmpdir copy of the repo with a tampered registry — which tests/gate-poison-pills.test.mjs already constructs in-process and far more cheaply, asserting the exact false-green that matters: an EMPTY registry reports every gate as undeclared rather than passing clean. It also produced live negative evidence during its own bring-up by failing on itself the moment it entered the check chain.
exempt.node scripts/check-skill-refs.mjs: skills:check member. Reference-integrity linter over skills/**: it resolves every reference row against disk on each run, so its verdict is re-derived rather than certified about a stored artifact — there is no stale output to construct.
exempt.node scripts/check-gate-contracts.mjs: skills:check member. The contract validator itself; pilling it would mean contracting the thing that decides what a contract is. Its negative evidence is tests/gate-honesty.test.mjs plus live failures it produced during this session — it rejected a contract naming a non-existent oracle, and rejected all five CLI-gate contracts until their tests genuinely referenced the gate ids they claimed.
exempt.node scripts/check-stale-skill-surface.m: skills:check member. Asserts the ABSENCE of a .github/skills/ or .agents/skills/ tree that would shadow .claude/skills/. The tamper is creating a directory, which the overlay contract (whose destination must already exist, so a fixture can never be an orphan the gate never reads) cannot express; the behaviour is covered by the script own tests.
